sidebar.title: Shifts

indexentry.indexdefn: A shift is a ±2 modifier to the skill die result used to represent various effects on the outcome of a check. A shift up is +2, a shift down is -2.

sidebar.p:
Shifts are ±2 modifiers to the skill die result used to represent various effects on the outcome of a check. A shift up is +2, a shift down is -2. Some examples of things that might cause shifts are:
Cover or long range when using a missile weapon
Darkness during combat
Rain when casting a spell
